useCases.tool: concrete pump hose, poker vibrator, screed board, rebar tying tool
useCases.sensing: concrete cover, slab level and flatness
useCases.reason: Mesh mats of 34 to 132 kg carried across the open excavation and a load-bearing pour; pumps and laser screeds already do the machine part.

useCases.tool: crane, tag line, push-pull props, shims and bedding mortar
useCases.sensing: position and plumbness against the erection plan
useCases.reason: Stairs, walls and columns weighing tonnes (a stair flight alone 1.4 to 9.6 t, large solid walls more) hang on the crane, are load-bearing and must be braced before the hook is released from a ladder or platform.

useCases.tool: crane with 4- or 8-leg sling or spreader beam, props and beams
useCases.sensing: element position and bearing against the laying plan
useCases.reason: Slab elements of about 2.5 to 5 t hang on the crane and become formwork and bottom reinforcement of the slab, laid at the open edge; this stays with the crane and a laying crew.
